# Alejandro Cuba Ruiz

> Principal Front-End Engineer, Google Developer Expert in Angular, International Speaker, Host of Angularidades, and Top ADPList Mentor based in Miami Beach, FL.

## About
This is the personal website and portfolio of Alejandro Cuba Ruiz.

- **Role**: Principal Front-End Engineer & Google Developer Expert (GDE) in Angular.
- **Location**: Miami Beach, FL, USA
- **Bio**: Connecting global developer communities through conference speaking, meetups, podcasts, technical writing, and active mentorship.
- **Specialties**: Modern Web Architecture, Angular, Web Performance, Design Systems, JavaScript & TypeScript, Community Leadership.
- **Handles**: @alejandrocuba, @alejandrocubaruiz, @zorphdark
